name: com.varosyanllc/company-data
title: Varosyan company and tender data
description: Companies from official national registers, with public tenders, awards and dated signals.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies by name or registration number in every live country, or in one country (a code from list_countries), optionally filtered by status and industry.

country.description: A live country code from list_countries, e.g. no, gb, fr. Leave out for every country.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One company with registrations, sites, contacts, tenders won and (on paid plans) people, signals and a buying-intent score. Companies from national registers also carry annual figures, a timeline of events, flags (bans, auditors, charities, sanctions, care ratings), owner companies, branches and parent, trademark, patent and design counts, and the licence lines to show with the data. Use the country and slug from a search result URL.

slug.description: The last part of the company's page address

include_proof.description: Add the source and check date of every value

tools.name: get_signals
tools.description: Recent dated buying signals in every live country, or one country.

type.description: tender_won: Won a public contract; tender_bid: Bid for a public contract (Qatar and Bahrain); open_tender: A tender opened (Qatar and Bahrain); contract_ending: A public contract ends within 12 months: likely re-tender; newly_registered: Newly registered or licensed (Qatar and Bahrain); new_branch: A new branch; moved_office: Moved its registered office; hiring: Hiring (Qatar and Bahrain); announcement: Announcement or disclosure (Qatar and Bahrain); growing: Turnover or staff up year on year; shrinking: Turnover or staff down year on year; leadership_change: A director, chief executive, chair or board member joined or left; ownership_change: A shareholder or owner joined or left; new_product: A new trade mark, patent or design; financial_risk: Insolvency, liquidation, Gazette notice, new charge, tax prohibition, suspension or strike-off; hiring_now: Open vacancies posted in the last 60 days (Latvia, Norway); public_funding: State aid or a grant received; capital_raised: Share capital raised; acquisition: Took over or merged with another company, bought a business, or a new parent company

country.description: A live country code from list_countries, e.g. no, gb, fr. Leave out for every country.

tools.name: get_tenders
tools.description: Open or recently awarded government tenders in every live country, or one country, optionally matching keywords in the title or reference (q).

country.description: A live country code from list_countries, e.g. no, gb, fr. Leave out for every country.

tools.name: get_retenders
tools.description: Re-tender radar: public contracts that end in 3 to 18 months, soonest first, with the buyer, the end date and (on paid plans) the company holding the contract and its value. From the award notices of the national register countries.

country.description: A live country code from list_countries, e.g. no, gb, fr. Leave out for every country.

months_from.description: Ends at least this many months from today (default 3)

months_to.description: Ends before this many months from today (default 18)

q.description: Keywords in the contract or the buyer

tools.name: get_bidders
tools.description: Every company that bid on a Qatar or Bahrain tender, with winners and values (paid plans).
